notes: Adds the HAL_v1 TimeIf methods and shared saturating ns/tick conversion helpers, publishes RV64 QEMU DTB timebase-frequency through PlatformInfo, treats absent/zero/invalid timebase data as the documented qemu virt fallback, implements rdtime plus legacy SBI set_timer deadlines for RV64 QEMU, and keeps LA64/M1 mock boards as explicit compile stubs. No EBR/zone or tx-reactor code was touched.
